description: Send one GET to a URL as each of nine common clients (curl, node, Python urllib, Python requests, libwww-perl, a Chrome browser, GPTBot, ClaudeBot, Googlebot) and report which are refused and why, such as a Cloudflare 1010 block on Python's urllib. Also reports robots.txt blocks on AI crawlers, whether /llms.txt exists, and whether the http-to-https redirect keeps POST bodies. Use before relying on a site or API from code, or to check your own. Read-only; private addresses are refused. Costs $0.010 in USDC on Base, paid via the x402 protocol, or from a credit token — call credits_trial for free credit if you have neither.

credit_token.description: Optional. A credit token from credits_trial or /credits/buy. Supplying it pays for this call from that balance, so no x402 payment or wallet is needed.

name: reach

error.description: 'timeout' or 'unreachable' when there was no response

status.description: HTTP status, or null if no response

truncated.description: A 200 shorter than its declared Content-Length

http_redirect.description: How http:// redirects to https://, and whether POST survives it

llms_txt.description: Whether /llms.txt is a real text file

measured_from.description: Where the scan ran, and what that means for the results

robots_txt.description: robots.txt status and the AI crawlers it shuts out of the whole site

verdict.description: 'pass' (every client reached), 'shadowed' (some refused while others reached: the fixable finding), 'refused' (all refused) or 'unreachable'

title: Check whether agents can reach a URL
